class.name: FmodListener3D
class.brief_description: A 3D node that acts as an FMOD audio listener.
class.description:
FmodListener3D registers this node's position, orientation, and velocity as an FMOD audio listener. FMOD uses listener data to spatialize audio from [FmodEventEmitter3D] nodes, including distance attenuation, directional audio, and Doppler effects.
FMOD supports up to 8 simultaneous listeners (indices 0–7). The [member listener_index] must be unique across all listeners in the scene. Multiple listeners are blended according to their [member weight], which is useful for split-screen setups.
The listener automatically registers itself when entering the scene tree and unregisters when leaving.

method.name: get_listener_weight
method.description: Returns the blend weight of this listener.

method.name: get_locked
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if this listener's position is locked and will not update automatically.

method.name: set_listener_index
method.description: Sets the listener index (0–7). Each active listener must have a unique index.

method.name: set_listener_weight
method.description: Sets the blend weight of this listener. Used when multiple listeners are active to blend their influence on the final mix.

method.name: set_locked
method.description: Locks or unlocks the listener. When locked, the listener's position is not updated from this node's transform. Use [method FmodServer.set_listener_transform3d] for manual control.

members.member: If [code]true[/code], the listener's position is not updated automatically from this node's transform.
The listener slot this node occupies (0–7). Must be unique among all active listeners.
Blend weight for this listener. Determines its influence relative to other active listeners.
